title: Emergency Management Controller
description: Cloud controller. Configuration selects zone CRI from the declared MGA assessment and pushes changes exceeding its configured threshold through updatePriority. Alarm handling forwards the originating alarm message to the EMUs serving its hazard factor. Firmware priority calculation, scheduler selection and mitigation policy are outside this interface.

configure.title: Configure EDU
configure.description: Returns zone, contextualRiskIndex and issuedAt. Declared hazard factors route alarms to EMUs; they do not prescribe a priority computation or alter the MGA assessment configuration.
